listing.name: Larger Zoom Out
listing.summary: This simple mod increases the maximum camera range you can zoom out on the battle and campaign screens.
listing.aiSummary: Increases the maximum camera zoom-out range on battle and campaign screens.

description:
This simple mod increases the maximum camera range you can zoom out on the battle and campaign screens.

From 2.0 to 4.0 in combat.
From 3.0 to 4.0 in campaign.

Optionally, you can change the settings in the "settings.json" in the "config" folder.

Download

From 2.0 to 4.0 in combat:

Spoiler

From 3.0 to 4.0 in campaign:

Spoiler
